$comment: Accepted npm advisories: unfixable upstream with unreachable entry points in our usage. Every entry must name the GHSA id, the affected package, and why it is accepted. npm audit has no --ignore flag, so scripts/npm-audit-check.mjs enforces this list (CI runs `npm run audit`). Re-check entries when the dependency tree changes.

allow.reason: Code injection via _.template imports. lodash is unmaintained (4.17.23 is final, no patch). Not reachable: our src never imports lodash, and neither mermaid nor dagre-d3-es calls _.template (verified by grep over node_modules). Client-only impact in the diagram renderer.

Prototype pollution via _.unset/_.omit array path bypass. Same unmaintained-lodash situation. Not reachable: neither mermaid nor dagre-d3-es calls _.unset or _.omit (verified by grep over node_modules). Client-only impact in the diagram renderer.
